generationInputs.prompt: A fair-skinned older woman with glasses gently smiles behind a wooden table laden with various food items in a warm kitchen setting. The woman has light gray shoulder-length wavy hair, parted to her left, and wears a gray V-neck shirt, a light beige cardigan, gold hoop earrings, and a thin gold necklace with a small pendant. Her hands rest on the wooden table. The table displays a small wooden bowl of green pumpkin seeds, a red bell pepper, a small wooden bowl of tan grains, a wooden cutting board with raw red meat, a clear glass of white liquid, a red apple, a green apple, a single avocado, a wooden bowl of red strawberries, and a bunch of yellow bananas arranged from left to right. Behind the woman, a kitchen wall with brown and beige square tiles on the lower part and muted beige above features two wooden shelves. The top shelf holds a terra cotta bowl of yellow bananas, a larger terra cotta bowl, and a small terra cotta pot with a green leafy plant, while the lower shelf contains a small terra cotta jar with a lid, a small glass jar, a larger terra cotta bowl, a small potted green plant, and a dark-colored mortar and pestle. A glimpse of another dark object is visible on the countertop to the right.
